name: SMBD Core

frame.doc: D3DDevice_Swap (XbSymbolDatabase match): once per presented frame, before the swap. core::frame_count() counts these.

pad_read.doc: XInputGetState(handle, XINPUT_STATE*) has returned (stdcall, 8 bytes of arguments). core::pad(ctx) is the state the game will see; edit it to change input.

description: The shared hook layer every other mod builds on. Events: frame (once per presented frame) and pad_read (controller state, editable). Always on.
